scope: Preservation and practical instruction review of the nine original shop-inspired fillings, hand-shaping hub, mold and plastic-wrap adapters.
method: Independent source comparison, programmatic equality checks of original filling ingredient groups and preparation bodies, and manual review of shaping branches and note placement. This is not a cooking trial or a live-page verification.
verdict: No remaining publication-blocking preservation or instruction issue found within this scope.

preparation_exceptions: Soboro retains its cooking instructions and original optional yolk pairing; the pairing now links to the separate yolk recipe and explicitly requires preparing that optional second filling a day ahead.
Shiso kombu retains its cooking instructions; its conflicting one-week keeping sentence now refers to the original combined Keeping note's 4–5-day period.
context_and_notes: Shop inspiration and home-version attribution survive. The hub distinguishes Bongo combinations, Yadoroku traditional fillings and Nigihaya mixed eggplant.
The original Buy and fill note survives on the hub, including sujiko, negitoro, salmon with mentaiko, grilled tarako with mentai mayo, kazunoko and ami tsukudani.
Fuki miso survives on the hub and peanut-miso page with obsolete step numbering removed.
Nigihaya's Marizuke explanation survives on the eggplant page with the quick-home-version distinction.
Mentai mayo on takana remains an optional linked combination.
Volatile historical menu-count and Michelin-status claims are deliberately omitted from the new hub; they are not represented as freshly verified facts.

resolved_findings: The split uses the original nine shop-inspired fillings rather than substituting the unrelated six basic fillings.
Four cured yolks yield four onigiri, with 480 g cooked rice and four nori strips.
Eggplant mixes throughout the rice; pepperoncino uses the original approximately 1 tsp per piece with explicit excess oil, rather than pouring the entire batch into the rice.
Seven center-filled recipes remain distinct from the two mixed-rice recipes; no required second filling is added.
The hand-shaping hub, mold and wrap filling steps explicitly skip the well and separate filling for mixed rice.
The shared mixed-rice note is method-neutral and no longer instructs hand-shaping readers to fill a mold or wrap.
Mold pressure, filling spoon size, salt naming and nori quantity are clarified; wrap filling omits the contradictory bare-hand illustration.
Cooker and pot directions are present on the hub and alternative-method pages.
verification_outside_this_review: Localized export completeness, generated asset mapping, links, build and browser checks are verified separately by the implementing agent.
This report does not claim every original sentence is preserved verbatim or that the recipes reproduce unpublished shop recipes.

process_illustration_review.scope: All nine prep plates, seven well-filling plates, two mixed-rice mixing and shaping plates, and shared plain-rice triangle shaping
findings_fixed: Shiso prep: burner extinguished after adding shiso; kombu narrowed to thin strips.
Pepperoncino prep: burner extinguished after adding chilli.
checks: Exactly four curing yolks and one whole filling yolk
Eggplant and pepperoncino mixed throughout rice
Recipe-specific center fillings; enclosed plain-rice triangle shaping appropriate
Consistent painted animation style; no verified extra or conspicuously elongated digits
process_illustration_review.limits: Naturally occluded fingers cannot all be directly counted; existing cutaways covered by earlier review.
process_illustration_review.final_verdict: No remaining blocker in the focused process-image review.
